trigger: The first response-independent geometry run encountered the literal token NA in the public points table after Stage0 had already qualified 413 finite-coordinate sites from 421 rows.

allowed_fix.registry_definition: A modeling node is a trimmed nonempty Point_Name with finite numeric Latitude and Longitude in valid geographic ranges.
allowed_fix.missing_coordinate_row: exclude from the spatial registry before any response is opened; never impute, snap, borrow, or infer coordinates
allowed_fix.response_rows_for_sites_outside_registry: exclude from all model fitting, inner validation and outer scoring regardless of target value
allowed_fix.duplicate_site_with_one_or_more_finite_r: include only if all finite coordinate pairs for that Point_Name are identical; otherwise terminal pre-response geometry STOP

forbidden: use response occurrence to decide which missing-coordinate sites to retain
impute or snap coordinates after response access
change quantile levels or distance metric because of excluded rows
scientific_effect: Clarifies the response-independent registry universe only; does not use biological response and does not change the qualification threshold or world-quantile algorithm.
